conversion_patterns_applied: Stored Procedure Calls: EXEC [dbo].[proc] → SELECT schema.proc() or SELECT * FROM schema.proc()
DECLARE variables: Removed (not needed for PostgreSQL function calls)
Date Functions: FORMAT() → TO_CHAR(), DATEDIFF() → DATE_PART(AGE()), DATEPART() → EXTRACT(), GETDATE() → NOW()
Parameter Handling: SqlParameter → NpgsqlParameter, @ prefix maintained
